decisions.reason: With the standalone fouling detection system already withdrawn, the automation variant may be folded into broader offerings, but it still fits the energy-recovery strategy and costs little to keep in the automation portfolio.
The web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain and supports sales of the new flap weirs and overflow gates to engineering planners.
The spring-controlled flap weir is newly launched hardware close to the core flood-control business, and the firm will give it time to win projects.
Energy management for water facilities matches the firm's digitalization and efficiency strategy and rising utility demand for energy savings.
The overflow flap gate line is a multi-model core hydraulic-steelwork product with its own web page, signaling strong commitment.
